_comment: Example global data in the format the server sends. Places are real Gainesville parks, but the amenities, descriptions and trail routes are made up / approximate for testing. Trails here use gpx_file (relative to this file); the server sends the GPX text as gpx. The John Muir Trail (trails/John_Muir_Trail.gpx, all of it) is from OpenStreetMap via waymarkedtrails.org; the server sends only its first 29.9 km (trails/John_Muir_Trail_Yosemite_Valley.gpx), whose offline map is about 500 tiles. To send the whole trail instead, point the entry at John_Muir_Trail.gpx. Hawthorne-trail locales are fictional and snapped onto the track in trails/Gainesville-Hawthorne_State_Trail.gpx. John Muir Trail locales are real places along its Yosemite Valley section, snapped onto the track in trails/John_Muir_Trail_Yosemite_Valley.gpx at their trail mileage; their amenities and seasons are approximate, check with Yosemite before relying on them. The server starts with this file; to change a running server's copy: python server.py --load-global global/global_data.json

locales.name: Depot Park trailhead fountain
locales.description: Bottle-fill fountain at the western trailhead; potable

locales.name: Boulware Springs spigot
locales.description: Spigot behind the restroom building; potable, may be off in winter

locales.name: Prairie Rim primitive site
locales.description: Two tent pads under live oaks overlooking the prairie; no water, pack it in

locales.name: Sweetwater cistern
locales.description: Rain cistern with tap; untreated, filter or boil

locales.name: Prairie Creek bridge camp
locales.description: Fire ring and picnic table near the creek bridge; creek water must be treated

locales.name: Rochelle crossing hand pump
locales.description: Well hand pump at the County Rd 234 crossing; tested potable

locales.name: Lochloosa Pines group site
locales.description: Group site for up to 12, pit toilet, bear-proof food box

locales.name: Lochloosa Creek access
locales.description: Natural source below the boardwalk; tannic, filter before drinking

locales.name: Hawthorne trailhead overflow camp
locales.description: Grassy overflow field near the eastern trailhead; register at the kiosk

locales.name: Hawthorne trailhead spigot
locales.description: Potable spigot next to the eastern trailhead kiosk

locales.name: Happy Isles trailhead
locales.description: Start of the John Muir Trail; shuttle stop, restrooms and the mileage sign

locales.name: Vernal Fall footbridge fountain
locales.description: Drinking fountain by the footbridge restrooms; potable in season, last treated water for 13 miles

locales.name: Merced River above Nevada Fall
locales.description: River access upstream of the footbridge; filter or treat, and stay well back from the brink

locales.name: Little Yosemite Valley backpackers camp
locales.description: Large wilderness camp with a composting toilet and bear boxes; permit required

locales.name: Merced River at Little Yosemite Valley
locales.description: Easy river access below the camp; filter or treat

locales.name: Sunrise backpackers camp
locales.description: Camp by the Sunrise High Sierra Camp; bear boxes, open meadows, cold nights

locales.name: Sunrise camp spigot
locales.description: Spigot near the backpackers camp; potable in summer only, otherwise use the creek and treat it

locales.name: Long Meadow creek
locales.description: Slow creek through the meadow; filter, can run low by late summer

locales.name: Cathedral Pass
locales.description: High point of the section (about 9,700 ft) with views of Cathedral Peak and Matthes Crest

locales.name: Upper Cathedral Lake spur
locales.description: Short side trail to the lake; filter, no camping within 100 ft of the shore

trails.name: Gainesville-Hawthorne Trail
trails.description: Paved rail trail from Depot Park east past Boulware Springs

trails.name: John Muir Trail: Yosemite Valley section
trails.description: From Happy Isles in Yosemite Valley up toward Tuolumne Meadows; the first stretch of the trail to Mount Whitney
